text: dsh-trust-suite 是面向 DSH web profile 的信任插件组合包，通过 DSH bundle 一次加入十个独立插件，包括读写与网络规则检查、事件记录、工具和提示词变化检测、插件组合固定、压缩摘要检查、磁盘清理及状态面板。可用 dsh plugin 命令添加到指定 profile，也可运行仓库提供的安装脚本逐个从 GitHub 添加。适合希望集中安装这组 DSH 扩展的用户；本仓库源码只定义组合与安装流程，未包含这些依赖插件的实现。

dsh-trust-suite bundles ten trust plugins into a DSH profile. They cover read/write checks, event records, change detection, compaction review, cleanup, and a status panel. Install with the DSH profile command or included script. The dependencies provide the implementations.
想把一组 DSH 信任相关扩展一次装进 web profile。
How can I add the bundled trust plugins to a DSH profile in one step?
dsh-trust-suite 的功能「组合安装」：通过 dsh plugin --profile 指定目标 profile 并添加组合包，bundle 列出十个插件供 DSH 加入该 profile。
dsh-trust-suite 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 16；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-trust-suite README · dsh-trust-suite：Nine deterministic guards watch what a DSH agent **reads, writes, executes, spends, and remembers** — plus a plain-language [dashboard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-panel) and a [guardian pet](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-guardian-pet) that makes the state visible at a glance. Every decision is made by pure rule engines: **zero LLM calls in the trust path**, ~140 unit tests, verified against real DSH sessions.

dsh-trust-suite README · Install：```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-trust-suite ``` That single bundle installs all nine guards plus the dashboard. Prefer git checkouts? `./install.sh web` from this repo does the same from GitHub sources (everything ships prebuilt `lib/`, no `allowBuilds` approval needed). Individual guards are also installable on their own.

dsh-trust-suite README · Honest scope：> [!WARNING]
> **This is a policy-check and audit toolset, not a sandbox.** The guards make deterministic decisions at DSH's plugin hook points; they are not OS-level network controls, filesystem permissions, or a semantic guarantee that "the model was never influenced". Hard boundaries belong to the host sandbox, system permissions, or a proxy — layer this suite *on top of* those, not instead of them.

What each guard actually does, stated plainly:

dsh-trust-suite README · Honest scope：- **Detect** (report + ledger): mcp-test, prompt-drift, freeze, compaction-guard, janitor flag drift and leftovers — they do not block anything.
- **Enforce before the fact**: pr-gate denies out-of-scope file writes; egress-gate denies non-allowlisted web destinations (shell fetches are observe-only by default).
- **Mutate results**: read-guard wraps flagged content in a quarantine envelope (default) or blocks it — in wrap mode the original text is still in context, explicitly marked untrusted.
- **Record**: attest-chain appends a signed, hash-chained evidence record per tool result.
dsh-trust-suite README · Honest scope：Known boundaries are documented per guard in each repo's README — coverage limits, default-off modes, and trust-on-first-use for baselines.

dsh-trust-suite README · FAQ：**Does this call any LLM?** No. Every decision is a pure rule engine — same input, same verdict, auditable.

**Can I install just one guard?** Yes. Every guard is an independent npm package; the suite is only a convenience bundle. [dsh-trust-panel](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-panel) even works standalone — its read/egress engines ship inside the panel package.

dsh-trust-suite README · FAQ：**Does read-guard delete or rewrite the original file?** Never. It only changes what reaches the model's context, and only for high-severity findings in wrap/block mode.

**Windows?** Yes — CI runs Windows + Linux on Node 20/22/24 for every guard.

dsh-trust-suite README · FAQ：**Exact supported set** (as verified): Node ≥ 20 · npm ≥ 11.15 (staged publishing route) · DSH 0.2.x source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2 with host packages on the 0.1.2-rc.1 line · dsh plugin add installs via the official profile flow (pnpm). Plain-npm installs of the suite depend on the registry peer graph resolving cleanly — dsh-prompt-drift ≥ 0.1.1 carries the peer fix that makes that resolve.
